name: rewio
description: Find nonfiction book summaries in the ReWio catalog by topic, title, or author, and open the text or daily audio in ReWio.

interface.longDescription:
Find nonfiction book summaries by topic, title, or author in English, Slovak, and Czech. Choose a summary by reading or listening time, or open today's audio summary. ReWio is available on the web and as an iOS and Android app.

Web: https://rewio.app/
iOS: https://apps.apple.com/sk/app/rewio-book-summaries/id6504747872
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.elabdtech.rewio
capabilities: Filter by reading or listening time
defaultPrompt: Čo si môžem vypočuť o vyjednávaní po slovensky za 15 minút?
Najdi mi české knižní shrnutí o soustředění, které přečtu za deset minut.
What book summary can I listen to today in English?

positive.description: Find a Slovak summary by its exact title
positive.prompt: Use ReWio to find the Slovak book summary of Modré zóny.
positive.expected_behavior: Return Modré zóny by Dan Buettner as the first match and link to its Slovak ReWio page.

positive.description: Find Czech summaries with a reading limit
positive.prompt: Najdi mi v ReWio české knižní shrnutí o soustředění, které přečtu za deset minut.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the Czech text filter with a ten-minute reading limit and link to matching ReWio summaries.

positive.description: Find English summaries with a listening limit
positive.prompt: Use ReWio to find an English book summary about negotiation I can listen to in 15 minutes.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the English audio filter with a 15-minute listening limit and link to matching ReWio titles.

positive.description: Open the daily or starter audio without a ReWio account
positive.prompt: What free book summary can I listen to today in English on ReWio?
positive.expected_behavior: Return direct listening links for the current English daily and starter summaries when available. The links open the ReWio web player and playback can be started without a ReWio login.

positive.description: Look up a known Czech catalog ID
positive.prompt: Use ReWio to open the Czech book summary with catalog ID 1763291294279000.
positive.expected_behavior: Return Jak prokouknout druhé lidi and its Czech ReWio page.

negative.description: Daily news is outside the catalog
negative.prompt: Summarize today's world news for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Answer with an appropriate news workflow without calling a ReWio tool.

negative.description: The user wants a full audiobook for purchase
negative.prompt: Where can I buy the complete Think Simple audiobook?
negative.expected_behavior: Handle the purchase lookup outside ReWio and avoid presenting a summary as the full book.

negative.description: A general question needs no book lookup
negative.prompt: Explain the difference between a habit and a routine in two sentences.
negative.expected_behavior: Answer directly without calling a ReWio tool.

review.commerce_description: ReWio provides catalog results and listening links. The plugin does not initiate purchases or subscriptions.

publication.release_notes: Initial public version with book summary search, reading and listening time filters, and links to the daily and starter audio.

sk-SK.subtitle: Knižné súhrny a audio
sk-SK.description:
Vyhľadaj súhrny kníh literatúry faktu podľa témy, názvu alebo autora v slovenčine, češtine a angličtine. Vyber si podľa času na čítanie či počúvanie alebo si otvor dnešný audio súhrn. ReWio je na webe aj ako mobilná aplikácia.

Web: https://rewio.app/
iOS: https://apps.apple.com/sk/app/rewio-book-summaries/id6504747872
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.elabdtech.rewio

Web: https://rewio.app/
